_comment: Custom model providers for pi, written by chezmoi to ~/.pi/agent/models.json.
pi merges these with the providers it discovers itself (anthropic,
openai, google -- cached in models-store.json, which is pi's
and not ours to edit). Only providers pi cannot find on its own belong here.
Enabling is separate: a provider defined here still has to be listed in
settings.json enabledModels as <provider>/<model> or <provider>/*.
openai: Sign in with ChatGPT (subscription). pi's catalogue carries the
ChatGPT backend's default context (272k). Measured 2026-10-31 on 6.1 Sol:
917k input tokens accepted, 940k rejected, i.e. the model's 1.05M minus its
128k output, 922k. Codex treats Astra the same (max_context_window equal for
both). No long-context fee on subscription usage. Drop an override once pi's
catalogue matches.
No meta block: since 2026-10 Meta rejects Muse Code subscription keys from
any client but Muse Code (403 client_attestation_denied), and Wonder Full is
Muse Code only. Use the muse CLI for Meta; a pay-as-you-go key is ruled out.
lmstudio: LM Studio on the pro Mac, reached through llama-swap on :8000
(~/.config/llama-swap), which unloads MTPLX first so the two are never
loaded together; LM Studio JIT-loads the model with its saved defaults and
llama-swap unloads it after 15 idle minutes. ids are `lms ls` identifiers;
qwen3.8-27b is unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF UD-Q4_K_XL, which embeds the MTP
layer. Its JIT load defaults (128k context, MTP, draft 3; ~26 tok/s vs ~13
without) are ~/.lmstudio/.internal/user-concrete-model-default-config/
unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF/*.json -- without them LM Studio JIT-loads at a
4k context and rejects pi's prompt. The key is a dummy LM Studio ignores. On machines without
LM Studio running this just fails to connect.
contextWindow is what we load them with, not the 262k native max -- raise
it together with the context length in LM Studio's load settings.
mtplx: llama-swap on 127.0.0.1:8000 (~/.config/llama-swap) starts
`mtplx serve` on the first request and stops it after 15 idle minutes; the
first turn after that waits ~10 s for the load. ~36 tok/s. Block mirrors what
MTPLX's own pi.py generates (compat/thinkingLevelMap); we keep it here by
hand because `mtplx start pi` would rewrite this file (chezmoi would undo it).
The Qwen3.8 27B Optimized Speed pack ships a vision tower (/v1/models
reports supports_vision), so image input is on.
